Preserved original Flutter source at upstream9ce5e167. This repository is an archive with source hash provenance, not a production signed phone binary or a faithful third-party replica claim.

Run verify_provenance.py before Flutter pub get. Toolchain Flutter3.41.9/Dart3.11.5. No guaranteed search indexing/ranking implied by this optional file.
